title: Esterification process catalyzed by ZSM-5 zeolite synthesized via modified hydrothermal method
author: Ben Mya, Bita, et al.
materials: OAME was prepared via a rapid derivatization procedure. An aliquot (35.15 ml) of OFFA, 20 ml of methanol and 1.77 ml sulfuric acid solution (10 Wt%) were added into the Pyrex screw-cap tube (16 × 125 mm). The tube was vortexed for 10 s before being stirred to become homogeneous under 85 °C water bath for 15 min for acidic esterification. Afterwards, catalysis tests were carried out in the reactions and performed in a round-bottom glass flask with two-neck vol–250 ml equipped with a reflux condenser in a crystallizer. An excess of methanol was added to the flask containing the oleic acid in order to shift the equilibrium towards ester formation with a molar ratio of 1:4.5 (oleic acid:methanol). 4.5 (oleic acid:methanol). ZSM-5 catalyst (10 wt.% by weight, based on the oleic acid) was added to catalyze the esterification without it depends on the concentration of the reaction substrate. The crystallizer is placed on a hot plate about 70 °C with magnetic stirring about 450 rpm, maintaining the stability of the degree of the temperature through the thermocouple installed. Connecting the condenser in a small submersible pump placed in a water bath containing an amount of ice. This system condenses the vapor from the reaction to maintain the amount of the reactants. The esterification reaction is started and stay for three hours, several samples are taken at different times (0:10:30; 30:30:180 min) by Pasteur pipette, the samples are then separated by centrifuge. In order to regularize biodiesel acidity, OAME was placed in a separator funnel 60 ml, washed with distilled water and then with dilute solution of sodium bicarbonate, until having a value (PH = 7). The tube containing the OAME extract was centrifuged at 1500g for 2 min and 1 μl of hexane phase was injected for GC analysis. steps.title: Prepare ZSM-5 synthesis gel
steps.instruction: Combine 0.0018 mol Al₂O₃, 0.075 mol NaOH, 0.030 mol H₂SO₄ (96 %), 4 g EDTA, and 25 ml SiO₂ 30 wt % (0.15 mol) in a beaker, stir for 30 min, and adjust pH to 11–12 until a zeolite gel forms.

steps.title: Hydrothermal aging of gel
steps.instruction: Filter the gel, place the filtered material in an oven at approximately 95 °C and age for 7 days.

steps.title: Filter, rinse and dry product
steps.instruction: After aging, gravity‑filter the solid, rinse repeatedly with water until the filtrate reaches pH ≈ 8, then dry the washed solid in air.

steps.title: Calcine zeolite powder
steps.instruction: Calcine the dried powder in a furnace at 800 °C for 2 h with a heating rate of 10 °C min⁻¹ to remove organics and develop the zeolite structure.

steps.title: X‑ray diffraction characterization
steps.instruction: Obtain an X‑ray powder diffraction pattern using a Bruker D8 Advance diffractometer, scanning from 10° to 50° 2θ.

steps.title: FT‑IR characterization
steps.instruction: Record FT‑IR spectra of the calcined zeolite on a Shimadzu 8400 s spectrometer over the range 400–4000 cm⁻¹.

steps.title: Prepare OAME pre‑reaction mixture
steps.instruction: In a Pyrex screw‑cap tube (16 × 125 mm), add 35.15 ml oleic free fatty acid (OFFA), 20 ml methanol, and 1.77 ml 10 wt % H₂SO₄ solution; vortex 10 s, then stir in an 85 °C water bath for 15 min to achieve homogeneous acidic esterification.

steps.title: Set up catalytic esterification with ZSM‑5
steps.instruction: Transfer the pre‑reaction mixture to a 250 ml two‑neck round‑bottom flask equipped with a reflux condenser placed in a crystallizer; add excess methanol to reach a molar ratio oleic acid : methanol of 1 : 4.5, add ZSM‑5 catalyst at 10 wt % based on oleic acid, heat on a hot plate to ~70 °C, stir magnetically at ~450 rpm, monitor temperature with a thermocouple, and connect the condenser to a submersible pump in an ice‑water bath to reflux vapors.

steps.title: Run reaction and collect samples
steps.instruction: Maintain the esterification reaction for 3 h, withdrawing aliquots at the following times: 0 min, 10 min, 30 min, 30 min (duplicate), and 180 min, using a Pasteur pipette; separate each withdrawn sample by centrifugation.

steps.title: Wash and neutralize OAME product
steps.instruction: Transfer the reaction mixture to a 60 ml separatory funnel, wash sequentially with distilled water and then with a dilute sodium bicarbonate solution until the aqueous phase reaches pH 7.

steps.title: Prepare sample for GC analysis
steps.instruction: Collect the organic (hexane) phase, centrifuge at 1500 g for 2 min, then inject 1 µl of the hexane layer into the gas chromatograph.

steps.title: Calculate OAME conversion
steps.instruction: Determine OAME conversion using the formula: OAME conversion % = (OAME after conversion (mol) / oleic acid in feedstock (mol)) × 100 %.
